   - ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR (fixes code) - repair.
   - VERIFIES_FIX: re-runs tests after repair.

3. The agent runs a test specifically to verify an edge case identified in prior analysis: agent's analysis identifies a potential concern → designs & executes a test to check it. This is a "designed verification test targeting identified edge case."

4. Reusing existing test scripts as part of a combined re-run command after making a modification (the re-run of all three tests). This is "regression test after fix" - re-executing previously passing tests to ensure the change didn't break existing behavior.
